svg.title: Source–readout formulation. The free readout (all separated correlations with all spectators) has a kernel on labels, and (FM4) computes it exactly: the information the free sector cannot see is the equation ideal and nothing else. The quotient map from radial labels to Winv d is the readout; the color-equivariant projection followed by radial reconstruction (Theorem 16.1) is its section. This is a quotient equivalence in the method’s classification, proved by a strict positivity argument and not assumed as nondegeneracy.
